versions.changelog:
mentions-full 1.0.1

- Added a security notice to SKILL.md for the watch_brand webhook, emphasizing use of HTTPS, HMAC signature verification, and secure handling of the webhook_secret.
- Removed the outdated skill-card.md file.
- No changes to main functionality or API; documentation and security guidance improvements only.

Initial release of the full MentionsAPI brand-visibility toolkit:

- Supports checking brand mentions, ranks, and citations across major AI engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews/AI Mode, Bing Copilot).
- Includes tools for checking mentions, discovering queries to track, comparing brands or queries, and monitoring mentions over time.
- Clear usage guidelines to avoid unnecessary API calls and credit use.
- Flexible pay-as-you-go pricing; $1 free credit on signup, no subscription needed.
- Comprehensive error handling and authentication via MENTIONSAPI_KEY.
